title: filago neglecta
intro: Filago neglecta, commonly known as rough fescue or false flax, is a perennial plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Filago neglecta include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents present in Filago neglecta work synergistically to provide its health benefits, including reducing oxidative stress and protecting against microbial infections.
